<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

req-0054 (magpie 2026-09-02, msg 888D45C1): a ruling to a WORKING omp returned `queued, reason:human-typing` and delivered on attempt 101, eight minutes late, after the seat had acted on the superseded order and moved a PR head under review. Cause: crates/daemon/src/delivery/mod.rs ~L231-260 runs fresh_injection_verdict on every pane seat with a socket-class transport; for omp/pi the agent OUTPUT streaming through the composer region reads as a human draft, so the politeness veto fires on every busy omp (magpie: all its seats, all afternoon; three visible failures — an 18-min idle coder, a reviewer waiting on a ruling already sent, a PR head moved under review). Second defect: the sender never learns a row is still queued or landed late; the only probe is sqlite by hand. Two units: u1 (urgent) omp/pi delivery never consults the composer veto — the extension stream buffers a steer until turn end, which IS the politeness; u2 sender notices.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

| id | text |
| --- | --- |
| g1 | A message to a working omp/pi seat is handed to the extension stream immediately; no composer capture, no human-typing veto for those harnesses. |
| g2 | A row still queued after N s (config, default 60) raises a pushed notice to the SENDER naming msg_id, recipient, reason, attempts; a row that later lands raises `delivered late (&lt;delay&gt;)`; the sender's next pij-rs command prints outstanding ones on stderr. |

## Non-goals

| id | text |

| n1 | Changing the veto for Claude/Copilot/Codex panes, where a human composer can exist. |
